summary: LG Display Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K to report a non-deal roadshow scheduled for April 28-30, 2026 in Seoul, sponsored by IBK Securities. The roadshow involves one-on-one meetings with domestic institutional investors to discuss Q1 2026 financial results and Q&A. No transaction, offer, or special situation is announced. This filing is purely informational and routine, not a special situation.
